title: Key Oscillator Character Identity
body_html:
Key Oscillator Character Identity

For elements in the stabilizer factors \(\Delta^i\) or in \(G_{x,s}\times G'_{x',s}\), the phase in the lattice-model action satisfies \[ \psi((1/2)\langle w,h^{-1}w-w\rangle_W) = \Gamma(g)\Gamma'(g') \] with the sign and inverse conventions of the paper.
proof_html: For \(\Delta^i\), expand \(g\) and \(g'\) by the exponential map and use the single-block stabilizer structure supercuspidal_theta.single_block_stabilizer_structure to replace \(h^{-1}w-w\) by the \(d\alpha^\perp\) term. The commutator correction pairs trivially with \(\Gamma'\) by centralizer properties. For depth \(s\) elements, the formula is the generalized lattice-model action formula rewritten through the two moment maps.
